Výuka zahrnuje přednášky s účastí předních odborníků v oblasti agroturistiky a chovu koní. Cvičení jsou prováděna formou blokových cvičení a závěrečnou, celodenní exkurzí do agroturistických zařízení zaměřených na chov koní v České republice a na Slovensku. Předmět "Agroturistika a chov koní" poskytne posluchačům sumu poznatků nezbytných pro provozování agroturistických provozů s chovem koní v České republice. Studium je zaměřeno na oblast legislativy podnikání a veterinárních předpisů, poskytování služeb spojených s využitím koní, organizaci a řízení agroturistického podniku, jízdáren a koňských stanic, manažerství a marketing těchto provozů, seznamuje posluchače s možnostmi budování koňských stezek a v neposlední řadě i využitím koní pro hiporehabilitaci. Zdůrazňuje i ekologickou funkci tohoto typu podnikání na českém venkově a možné problémy, které toto podnikání může přinést při ochraně krajiny a životního prostředí. (dotace 4/4)

Education includes lectures of experts in agritourism and horse breeding. Seminars are formed in blocks and in final excursion on agritouristic farms with horse breeding in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. Subject Agritourism and horse breeding (Agritourism 2) provides students all information which are necessary to start business in agritourism with horse breeding in the Czech Republic. Study is aimed on legislation of business, veterinary legislation and problems, services connected with horse breeding, management of agritouristic farm, riding halls and horse stations, horse trails, hiporehabilitation. A stress is putted on ecological function of this business in Czech countryside and possible environmental problems which can be brought by this kind of business. (allowance 4/4)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The subject Agritourism and horse breeding (Agritourism 2) informs students about all problems connected with business in agritourism and horse breeding. Students will get information which are necessary for start of business connected with agritourism, services, horse breeding, legislation etc.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Education includes lectures of experts in agritourism and horse breeding. Seminars are formed in blocks and in final excursion on agritouristic farms with horse breeding in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. Subject Agritourism and horse breeding (Agritourism 2) provides students all information which are necessary to start business in agritourism with horse breeding in the Czech Republic. Study is aimed on legislation of business, veterinary legislation and problems, services connected with horse breeding, management of agritouristic farm, riding halls and horse stations, horse trails, hiporehabilitation. A stress is putted on ecological function of this business in Czech countryside and possible environmental problems which can be brought by this kind of business. (allowance 4/4) a.Tourism, rural tourism, agritourism, eco-agritourismb.Rural tourism and agritourism abroad2.Business in agritourism with horse breeding (allowance 6/6) a.Analysis of condition for busines in agritourism with horse breedingb.Analysis of locality with a possibility to breed horsesc.Marketing of services in rural tourism and agritourismd.Accommodation in the countryside, certification of services, accommodation on a horse staionse.Catering in the countryside, organic food3.Utilization of horses in agritourism (allowance 8/8) a.Animal and plant production in agritourismb.Utilization of horses in agritourism, horse breeding in the Czech Republic and abroadc.Horse tourism, horse trails, horse stationsd.Hipotherapy4.Eco-agritourism and horse breeding (allowance 6/6) a.Eco-agritourism and rural development, organic farmingb.Problems of horse breeding in connection with environmental protectionc.ECEAT and Association of rural tourism and their support of agritouristic farms with horse breeding

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Conditions for final examination - attendance on theoretical exercises 80%, obligatory attendance on field exercises and excursions, composing and submitting of reports from excursions, composing and submitting of semestral work, presentation and successful defending of semestral work. Final examination - written test, 10 questions, point evaluation 0-1 point per question, minimum for successful examination 5 points.
